payload.text: D-ADR0073 (one word per tier): workflow is the versioned definition file (the term guide is retired; playbook is a workflow whose points are all listed-routes-only), case is one instance of a workflow with its own ledger, milestones, frame and consent, unit is one piece of work handed to the run door inside a case or standalone, loop is one of the four code engines, pattern is a loop plus default params, invariants and a promise, seat is a role in a pattern, and the noun run means only one execution of one seat (the word attempt is dropped); commands stay: fgos run runs a unit and fgos workflow start opens a case
payload.rationale: The word pattern named both code engines and named param bundles, workflow named the component, the definition and an instance, and run named three tiers (wf-run is a case, unit-run is a unit, runs/NN is a seat execution), which caused repeated misreadings while designing how the degree of applying a pattern is declared; owner 2026-10-24 12:45 ok giu case, chot bo tu di em
payload.alternatives: Keep guide (confused with how-to guides); workflow instance instead of case (long, reintroduces run); attempt for a seat execution (two words for one tier); renaming the fgos workflow verbs (start already reads as opening an instance)
